mission: Connect YHVH GOSPEL TV with Gospel and Christian radio stations, networks, web radio and audio distributors worldwide.
rights_rule: A station may be listed as a prospect without implying partnership, endorsement, carriage or rights. Broadcast use requires documented rights and applicable territory/regulatory clearance.
editorial_rule: Payment, sponsorship or distribution participation does not purchase editorial approval or guaranteed airtime.
territory_gate: All audio distribution follows the YHVH territory rights registry and route policy. Default is REVIEW_REQUIRED until rights are verified.

initial_research.observed_scale: 5,794 Christian radio stations across listed continents in the current directory snapshot
initial_research.note: Directory counts are discovery leads, not verified partnerships. Each station must be independently verified before outreach or agreement.

priority_waves.focus: Major Christian radio networks and African Gospel broadcasters
